usage.outputShape: body.content (assistant text, plain string); body.model (resolved model slug); body.usage.* (token counts + upstream cost)
quirks: Response is NOT standard OpenAI shape: the assistant text is at body.content (a plain string), NOT body.choices[0].message.content. There is no choices[] array in the response.

Despite the registry name 'OpenAI GPT-4o / o-series', the URL path is /api/llm/gpt-5.1 and the returned model is 'openai/gpt-5.1-20251113'. The endpoint serves gpt-5.1, not GPT-4o/o-series. Sending a 'model' param to override was not tested.
x402 paid $0.035 USDC on Base (eip155:8453); also advertises USDm (eip155:4326) and Solana payment rails.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/llm/gpt-5.1 with an OpenAI-style chat body: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"your prompt"}]}. Pay the $0.035 USDC x402 charge on Base. Read the assistant's reply from body.content (a plain string) — this endpoint does NOT return the standard OpenAI choices[] array. Token usage and upstream cost are in body.usage. The served model is gpt-5.1 (body.model) despite the registry label saying GPT-4o/o-series.
